topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite orbital configurations can optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays through informed path selection, considering link characteristics like latency. This synergy enables effective capacity management, minimizing interference and maximizing signal quality for latency-sensitive traffic classes.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms neglect fixed signal propagation times, impacting performance in integrated satellite and terrestrial networks.
